title: "Held with no drawing" was worked out in two places with different checks: redraw and applyInTurn
evidence: From the PR 1681 review. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift redraw (:266) guarded on drawn != nil || (problem == nil && !recordJSON.isEmpty && !predatesErase); applyInTurn (:400) refused on predatesErase || (drawn == nil && problem == nil). PR 1684: one named property, RecordStore.heldUndrawn (RecordStore+Readable.swift: drawn nil, problem nil, recordJSON not empty, not predatesErase). redraw reads drawn != nil || heldUndrawn; applyInTurn reads predatesErase || heldUndrawn || (drawn == nil && problem == nil && recordJSON.isEmpty), the last term keeping its refusal of a store with no record yet. Both equal the old conditions on all 16 inputs (checked by hand and by an exhaustive script in review, not by a test); HeldUndrawnTableTests.swift pins heldUndrawn's 16 rows as literals. US-25 AC16f
